summary: Built complete data layer and API integration for vlrggapi. Created typed API service functions for all endpoints (/v2/stats, /v2/player, /v2/player/matches, /v2/match, /v2/match/details, /v2/team, /v2/events, /v2/events/matches, /v2/rankings, /v2/news). Implemented two-tier caching: server-side in-memory cache with TTLs in the API client, plus TanStack Query staleTime configs for client-side deduplication. Created internal domain models (Player, Team, Tournament, Match) and mappers from API response shapes to internal models. Added prefetch helpers for warming player/team directories across all VCT regions.
notes: Two-tier caching strategy: (1) server-side in-memory cache with per-endpoint TTLs aligned to upstream API caching (30s for live, 5min for match details, 30min for stats/profiles, 1hr for rankings), (2) TanStack Query staleTime to prevent redundant client-side refetches. Rate limiter enforces 600 req/min. Prefetch functions (prefetchDirectories, prefetchPlayerDirectory, prefetchTeamDirectory) can be called from route loaders to warm caches across all VCT regions. vlr.gg numeric IDs are mapped to vlrId fields in internal models, extracted from API responses and URL patterns.
